description: Escalate the conversation to a human agent. Only after the customer agreed to be escalated, or explicitly asked for a person.

instruction.instruction: Call this ONLY when (a) the customer explicitly asks for a human agent or a person, or (b) you asked 'Would you like me to escalate this to a human agent?' and the customer answered yes. Never call it straight after a request you cannot complete (e.g. initiating a refund) - ask the question first and wait. If the customer answers no, do not call it.
